title.zh: 联邦信息与信息系统安全分类标准
title.en: Standards for Security Categorization of Federal Information and Information Systems

entries.relatedPolicy: Related entries are distinct concepts; no merge or replacement is implied.

zh.principle: **标准**：联邦信息与信息系统安全分类标准（Standards for Security Categorization of Federal Information and Information Systems）。FIPS 199 的骨架是`目标 × 影响等级`：§3 写「The security categories are based on the potential impact on an organization should certain events occur which jeopardize the information and information systems needed by the organization to accomplish its assigned mission, protect its assets, fulfill its legal responsibilities, maintain its day-to-day functions, and protect individuals.」并借 FISMA 给出三个安全目标——「The FISMA defines three security objectives for information and information systems」，分别是保密性、完整性与可用性，其中保密性的定义直接引自 44 U.S.C.：「Preserving authorized restrictions on information access and disclosure, including means for protecting personal privacy and proprietary information」，原文在此之后附上 [44 U.S.C., Sec.3542] 的出处标注。
zh.why: 之所以需要统一分类，是为了让风险判断可比：正文强调「Security categories are to be used in conjunction with vulnerability and threat information in assessing the risk to an organization.」并在目标之外定义后果——「A loss of confidentiality is the unauthorized disclosure of information.」，把`泄露/篡改/失效`映射到可讨论的影响值上。
zh.used: 适用与算法都写死：§2「These standards shall apply to: (i) all information within the federal government other than that information that has been determined pursuant to Executive Order 12958, as amended by Executive Order 13292, or any predecessor order, or by the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, as amended, to require protection against unauthorized disclosure and is marked to indicate its classified status」——排除条件是已依行政令定密并标注密级，且「Agency officials shall use the security categorizations described in FIPS Publication 199 whenever there is a federal requirement to provide such a categorization」。系统级取值规则是取最高——「For an information system, the potential impact values assigned to the respective security objectives (confidentiality, integrity, availability) shall be the highest values (i.e., high water mark) from among those security categories that have been determined for each type of information resident on the information system」。
zh.broken: 模型只在登记的输入域与参数假设内成立；越界输入、密钥复用、实现偏离规范与版本差异都会使结论失效。
zh.history: 标准名为「Standards for Security Categorization of Federal Information and Information Systems」，文件日期栏写 February 2004，即 2004 年 2 月；生效方式写明「These standards are effective upon approval by the Secretary of Commerce.」，与后续 NIST 指南的分工也在 §1 交代——「Subsequent NIST standards and guidelines will address the second and third tasks cited.」

**形式模型与复算步骤**

\[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\]

联邦信息与信息系统安全分类标准的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。1.读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数。2.按标准表换算等效强度。3.取最弱分量作为系统强度。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

en.principle: **Standard**: Standards for Security Categorization of Federal Information and Information Systems (联邦信息与信息系统安全分类标准). The skeleton of FIPS 199 is objectives crossed with impact levels: §3 states "The security categories are based on the potential impact on an organization should certain events occur which jeopardize the information and information systems needed by the organization to accomplish its assigned mission, protect its assets, fulfill its legal responsibilities, maintain its day-to-day functions, and protect individuals." and takes the three objectives from FISMA — "The FISMA defines three security objectives for information and information systems" — confidentiality, integrity and availability, with confidentiality quoted from 44 U.S.C. as "Preserving authorized restrictions on information access and disclosure, including means for protecting personal privacy and proprietary information", the source appending the [44 U.S.C., Sec. 3542] attribution.
en.why: A shared categorisation exists so risk judgements become comparable: the text stresses "Security categories are to be used in conjunction with vulnerability and threat information in assessing the risk to an organization." and defines the consequences outside the objectives themselves — "A loss of confidentiality is the unauthorized disclosure of information." — mapping disclosure, tampering and outage onto discussable impact values.
en.used: Applicability and the aggregation rule are explicit: §2 "These standards shall apply to: (i) all information within the federal government other than that information that has been determined pursuant to Executive Order 12958, as amended by Executive Order 13292, or any predecessor order, or by the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, as amended, to require protection against unauthorized disclosure and is marked to indicate its classified status" — the carve-out is classified information that is so marked — and "Agency officials shall use the security categorizations described in FIPS Publication 199 whenever there is a federal requirement to provide such a categorization". At system level the value is the maximum — "For an information system, the potential impact values assigned to the respective security objectives (confidentiality, integrity, availability) shall be the highest values (i.e., high water mark) from among those security categories that have been determined for each type of information resident on the information system".
en.broken: Two limits are in the sentence set: categorisation does not cover every system, because the same clause excludes "all federal information systems other than those information systems designated as national security systems as defined in 44 United States Code Section 3542(b)(2)"; and it binds only the federal government, others "may consider" it — "State, local, and tribal governments as well as private sector organizations comprising the critical infrastructure of the United States may consider the use of these standards as appropriate."
en.history: The standard is named "Standards for Security Categorization of Federal Information and Information Systems" and dated February 2004 in its own front matter; effectivity is stated as "These standards are effective upon approval by the Secretary of Commerce." and the division of labour with later guidance is set out in §1 — "Subsequent NIST standards and guidelines will address the second and third tasks cited."

zh: 安全目标：保密性、完整性、可用性三项。
潜在影响：事件对组织、资产或个人的后果程度。
high water mark：系统分类取各信息类型的最高值。
not applicable：仅可用于保密性目标的影响取值。
national security system：由 44 U.S.C. 3542(b)(2) 定义并被排除的系统。
安全类别：目标与影响等级组合出的分类结果。
en: Potential impact: the degree of harm to organization, assets or individuals.
High water mark: the system category takes the highest value across information types.
Not applicable: an impact value allowed only for confidentiality.
National security system: defined in 44 U.S.C. 3542(b)(2) and excluded here.
Security category: the result of crossing objectives with impact levels.
